title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a hot ’82 show highlighted by a scorching Scarlet→Fire sequence, standout Let It Grow and Sugaree, with tight playing and memorable Brent solo.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is clean and well balanced, offering crisp drums, defined cymbals and a bright Jerry guitar tone despite a faint background hiss. Musically the concert is high‑energy, featuring seamless transitions (Playin→Scarlet→Fire), a fiery Let It Grow, sweet Sugaree, Phil’s booming bass on Sugar Magnolia and an inspired Brent solo during Fire, making it one of the more exciting 1982 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both performance (standout songs, tight playing) and recording quality (clear, balanced sound), with only minor technical quibbles.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and well‑balanced mix; slight background hiss noted by some listeners but overall crisp drums, defined cymbals and fresh keyboard tones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second‑set flow with seamless transitions, especially Playin→Scarlet→Fire; first set praised for energy and variety.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone described as clean, dynamic and bright; vocals noted as good.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted with "Phil bombs" on Sugar Magnolia and generally solid, though a few listeners wished for a bit more punch.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards praised as fresh; notable solo during Fire mentioned repeatedly.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums and cymbals well defined, providing strong rhythmic drive.
